description: Fork of exp312 (bf16 soft, 25K steps, bs=8). Out_proj: input_nap 10->6 (table_dim 1024->64), output_nap 32->64, tph 1024->512. Net weights 1*512*64*64 = 2.1M (vs 34M in exp312) — much smaller out_proj with wider output_nap and half the tables. Tests whether a lean many-tables arch with wider output_nap is competitive with deep-per-table.
